# Comet Foundry

> Comet Foundry is a hacker house and student-led innovation, entrepreneurship, and technology organization at the University of Texas at Dallas (UT Dallas), established Fall 2026. It is a physical space and community for students to build projects, ship ideas, and connect with peers and mentors — not a traditional club with recurring meetings. Founded by Vishva Patel.

## Key facts

- Name: Comet Foundry
- Type: Student organization / hacker house
- Location: UT Dallas, Richardson, Texas, USA
- Founded: Fall 2026
- Founder: Vishva Patel
- Contact: info@cometfoundry.com
- Website: https://www.cometfoundry.com
